text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Kamal Ganzouri: The Egyptian stock market attracts 126 mutual funds.
- President Mubarak met the Turkish Speaker of Parliament Mustafa Kalemli in Alexandria on Tuesday.
- Egypt highlights the necessity to respect Iraq's soverneigty and warns that the use of force could aggravate the situation in the region.
- Egypt says the situation in Iraq is against the stability in the region.
- Ganzouri in the economic conference on Tuesday: Four thousand new projects worth 50 billion pounds.
- Foreign Minister Amr Moussa to visit France today.
- Ganzouri: regional cooperation can not be achieved without peace. Talks with IMF on Oct 11.
